get.description: GET many request to retrieve multiple objects.

parameters.name: page[after]
parameters.description:
Pointer to paginate to retrieve the data after the object provided. Specify the `base64` encoded JSON string in a **uniquely identifiable** manner (e.g. object IDs), i.e. by using one (primary) or two (primary and secondary) fields that allow for **stable** sorting.
            

Format: `{"primary":{"someField": 123},"secondary":{"someOtherOptionalField": "Foo"}}`
            

Example: `{"primary":{"hashTypeId": 123}}` -> `eyJwcmltYXJ5Ijp7Imhhc2hUeXBlSWQiOiAxMjN9fQ==`

parameters.name: page[before]
parameters.description:
Pointer to paginate to retrieve the data before the object provided. Specify the `base64` encoded JSON string in a **uniquely identifiable** manner (e.g. object IDs), i.e. by using one (primary) or two (primary and secondary) fields that allow for **stable** sorting.
            

Format: `{"primary":{"someField": 123},"secondary":{"someOtherOptionalField": "Foo"}}`
            

Example: `{"primary":{"hashTypeId": 123}}` -> `eyJwcmltYXJ5Ijp7Imhhc2hUeXBlSWQiOiAxMjN9fQ==`

parameters.name: page[size]
parameters.description: Amout of data to retrieve inside a single page

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filters results using a query. Every key is an attribute name optionally suffixed with a comparison operator, e.g. `filter[hashTypeId__gt]=200`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Relationships to include in the response, comma seperated. Possible options:

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Attributes to sort by, comma separated, each optionally prefixed with `-` to sort descending, e.g. `sort=-description`. `id` addresses the primary key of the resource, and an attribute of an included resource can be addressed as `<relationship>.<attribute>`. The primary key is always appended as a tie-breaker, so that pagination over the result stays stable.

Accepted keys: id, description, isSalted, isSlowHash.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Attributes to return per resource type, comma separated, e.g. `fields[hashType]=description,isSalted`. Applies to the primary data and to included resources alike. A type that is not named is returned in full.

Attributes of `hashType`: description, isSalted, isSlowHash.

**Note:** a resource whose attributes are narrowed this way no longer carries every attribute listed as required in the response schema.

parameters.name: Upload-Metadata
parameters.description:
The Upload-Metadata header contains one or more comma-separated key-value pairs.
            Each pair is formatted as `<key> <base64(value)>`, where:
              - `key` is a string without spaces.
              - `value` is base64-encoded

parameters.name: Upload-Length
parameters.description:
The total size of the upload in bytes. Must be a positive integer.
          Required if `Upload-Defer-Length` is not set.

parameters.name: Upload-Defer-Length
parameters.description:
Indicates that the upload length is not known at creation time.
          Value must be `1`. If present, `Upload-Length` must be omitted.

Tus-Resumable.description:
Indicates the TUS version the server supports.
        Must always be set to `1.0.0` in compliant servers.

Location.description: Location of the file where the user can push to.
